AfterObtained.maps_to: no counterpart; kifuda.py is a behaviourless stub (3 class attributes, no methods)
AfterObtained.issue: Rollup of guards G1 and G2 per binding rule 4. Kifuda.cs:24-37 enchants up to 3 deck cards with Adroit at amount 3; the port does nothing at all.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the whole AfterObtained effect is missing, and the port's stated premise -- 'no enchantments in the sim' (kifuda.py:7-8) -- is FALSE
guards.issue: MECHANISM: Kifuda.cs:24-37 builds a CardSelectorPrefs with min 0 / max `DynamicVars.Cards.IntValue` == 3, Cancelable = false, then `CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForEnchantment(Owner, ModelDb.Enchantment<Adroit>(), 3, prefs)` and, for each pick, `CardCmd.Enchant(canonical.ToMutable(), item, 3m)` -- three deck cards permanently gain Adroit at amount 3. PREMISE CHECK (PROMPT.md bug class 12, and the shared sweep-stubs already flags this stub's premise as false): the sim HAS enchantments (`sts2_rl/enchantments.py`, 17 ported), HAS the relic-side attach idiom, and HAS the selection verb -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-kifuda` enumerates TWELVE live `run.select_cards("enchant", ...)` call sites, four of them relics doing exactly this shape (relics/beautiful_bracelet.py:26, relics/electric_shrymp.py:20, relics/paels_growth.py:22, relics/tri_boomerang.py:26). run.py:552 dispatches after_obtained. REACHABILITY (LIVE): Kifuda is Shop rarity in the transcribed grab bag (relic_probes_b08.py b08-pool: bag=Shop), the trigger is simply buying it, and the divergence is observable in every such run -- EXECUTED: add_relic('kifuda') leaves all 10 starting deck cards at enchantment=None where the game leaves three carrying Adroit(3). NOT dormant: the relic and the trigger are both ported and the code path is taken; what is missing is the relic's effect. FIX PREREQUISITE (named, per rule 6's spirit): the specific enchantment is unported -- `'adroit' in ALL_ENCHANTMENTS` is False, and src/Core/Models/Enchantments/Adroit.cs (OnPlay -> CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Amount), RecalculateValues sets Block.BaseValue = Amount) must be ported before this relic can be, so the gap cannot be closed by editing kifuda.py alone. Rule 7: enchantments.py, run.py, relics/beautiful_bracelet.py, relics/electric_shrymp.py, relics/paels_growth.py, relics/tri_boomerang.py and src/Core/Models/Enchantments/Adroit.cs are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: G2 (DORMANT): CardSelectorPrefs' `Cancelable = false` and the min-0/max-3 range, vs run.select_cards' fixed count
guards.issue: C# offers a not-cancelable screen whose selection size is 0..3 -- the player may confirm with fewer than 3 picks but may not back out -- while the sim's out-of-combat verb is `run.select_cards(purpose, candidates, count)` (run.py:371-390), which takes ONE count and has no min/max range or cancelable flag. Its default policy returns exactly `min(count, len(candidates))` picks. So a fixed port would enchant exactly 3 whenever 3 cards are eligible, where C# lets a player enchant 1. DORMANT and it stays dormant until G1 is fixed: with the relic implementing nothing, there is no screen to get wrong. It is recorded because the natural G1 fix (copy relics/beautiful_bracelet.py, which passes a fixed self.CARDS) inherits the same simplification, and because `RequireManualConfirmation` is the presentation half of the same prefs object (waived under N1). Rule 7: run.py and relics/beautiful_bracelet.py are not hashed by this record.
